analysis: INH (isoniazid) is a medication used primarily for the treatment of tuberculosis. One of the known side effects of INH is peripheral neuropathy, which is believed to be caused by its interference with the metabolism of pyridoxine, also known as vitamin B6. To prevent or treat INH-induced neuropathy, supplementation with pyridoxine is recommended.
